segments.he: הִתְקִין רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל הַזָּקֵן שֶׁתְּהֵא נוֹדֶרֶת כּוּ׳: אָמַר רַב הוּנָא, לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא בְּשֶׁלֹּא נִיסֵּת, אֲבָל נִיסֵּת – אֵין מַדִּירִין אוֹתָהּ.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «Rabban Gamliel the Elder instituted that she should take,» for the benefit of the orphans, «any vow» that the orphans wished to administer to her. «Rav Huna says: They taught» this halakha «only» in a case where «she did not marry» again; «however,» if «she married» again, «they do not administer a vow to her.»
